mandatoryCriteria: Expired restore denial: POST /api/v1/cards/:cardId/restore returns HTTP 410 RESTORE_WINDOW_EXPIRED when serverNow >= restore_until
Structured 410 error: Error response includes code=RESTORE_WINDOW_EXPIRED and details { serverNow, restoreUntil }
No retry extension: Retried restore requests cannot extend or reopen the expired window
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Strict 24h deadline enforcement and 410 RESTORE_WINDOW_EXPIRED response.
